summary: POMDOCTOR LIMITED filed a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing receipt of a November 5, 2026 Nasdaq staff letter confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) for the Nasdaq Global Market. The prior October 6, 2026 delisting determination, triggered by 30 consecutive sub-$1.00 closes, is resolved; the November 12, 2026 Hearings Panel session was cancelled, and Class A ordinary shares continue trading as POM. This is a routine listing-compliance update with no special-situation transaction, so no deal terms or arbitrage angle apply.
